author: Praxis V
title: BR‑WPCA (Batch‑Residual Weighted PCA) + batch-centering, nPC=100 (embed-only)
abstract: Compute gene weights from batch R^2 (intercept+dummies), downweight batch-driven genes w=(1−R2)^0.5, PCA to 100 dims, and per-batch mean-center PCs. Return only X_emb so evaluator builds neighbors. Hypothesis: boosts iLISI/kBET and PCR without harming cLISI/Graph_conn.
